messages.author: 8f3ca6cd76e8f00b
messages.subject: Satorra Bentler (2010) and information matrix
parts:
Hi everyone,

I'll try to be brief. When I try to compare nested models with MLR estimator, I keep getting this error:

## Warning in lav_test_diff_SatorraBentler2010(mods[[m]], mods[[m + 1]], H1 = FALSE): lavaan WARNING: information matrix of the M10 model is not positive definite. ## As a result, the scale-factor can not be computed.

I checked the information matrix of included models using lavInspect(..., "information") and I found that all the matrices from these models were symmetric and their diagonal elements were positive. Interestingly, the older version of the procedure (Satorra & Bentler, 2001) works like a charm. Moreover, this is not the only model I'm testing using this same approach (both simpler and more complex models are analyzed without any problems) - the error only occurs in one model. So... could anyone help me with determining what I am doing wrong? My model has five indicators, one latent variable and I'm trying to test invariance across two groups (n1 = 700+, n2 = 140).

Best regards and thanks in advance,

messages.author: 8f3ca6cd76e8f00b
messages.subject: Re: Satorra Bentler (2010) and information matrix
parts:
Another useful information I just figured out: the problem disappears if I remove sampling weights. Could it be that sampling weights are causing this issue? And, if yes, is there any way around this (as it would not be a very good idea to remove sampling weights)? Range of the included weights is between 0.625 and 1.667.

Best regards,
